items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Well, I didn't know him, but I knew he had other scholars, quite a bit of other scholars there.

ctx.x: Well, anyhow, back to your life and all I've kind of met, did your family play music in any way? No, no. I was the only one in the family that, uh,

took the music. And I started, I guess you'd like to know that, started trying to play a violin. And that was around in 1913. So I tried to play a violin when I kept it a couple of months with an instructor, somebody tried to show me. And I couldn't do anything with that. So then I changed my mind, and I got another instructor to show me how to play the trap drums. Mm-hmm. Because I liked that and thought I would do better. So I did do pretty good. I kept doing that for a couple of years. And something came up…
That must be Camille Nicholson's dad. Had a daughter named Camille? Probably so, probably.
